status: CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT: root-approved static ratio revision. Runtime validation required.
reference_units: native165x410 coordinates, scale uniformly with BottleVisual

free_surface.center: Use current physical solver free-surface plane h, never stored y from a sprite. Upright full109, half246 are QA examples only.
free_surface.radius_x: half visible cavity chord at h (about63px upright body)
free_surface.color: base mixed with14% white in sRGB; no white rim stroke. Optional within-face luminance variation ±3%, not extra opacity.
free_surface.clip: Ellipse/meniscus only on topmost occupied surface, clipped to same transformed cavity and active liquid region. No full ellipses on internal boundaries.
free_surface.chord_rule: ry=0.1111*visible_chord_width, native body126 gives14. Max16 at original165px canvas; scale uniformly. Full/half surface center remains solver h, not upper rim.

internal_interfaces.plane: Each boundary uses same cumulative-volume h_i solved by liquid shader. Never independent hand-authored layer y.
internal_interfaces.algorithm: Visible front arc only: apparent boundary d=10*sqrt(max(0,1-u*u)), u=tangent-distance/radius_x. Adjacent colors share exact same curve and use base body shading, no extra highlights. No independent plane offset.
internal_interfaces.top_surface_relation: internal_depth=0.0794*visible_chord_width, native126 gives10; about0.7143*free_surface_ry. No closed highlit internal ellipse.
internal_interfaces.color: Only adjacency of two palette colors; no white highlights, outline, duplicated dark rim, alpha gaps or extra ring. AA transition0.6-1.0native pixel.

tilt_integration.basis: Reuse solver gravity normal g and perpendicular tangent t. d=dot(p,g)-h_i and q=dot(p,t)-center_t. Top ellipse q²/rx²+d²/ry²<=1; internal front arc is evaluated in that same basis.
tilt_integration.chord: Compute visible chord/rx from same transformed cavity at solver h_i. Free ry=0.1111*chord and internal depth0.0794*chord, clamp free max16 native and smoothly shrink near neck. Apply same screen projection and transformed cavity clipping as solver.
tilt_integration.no_second_simulation: Use physical conserved volumes and current h_i for both body classification and surface decoration. No independently tweened ellipse, fixed bottle-local ellipse or decorative surface drifting off liquid during tilt.
tilt_integration.no_painting: All effects are runtime liquid geometry/shading. No fixed colored liquid is baked into glass assets.

qa_notes: Current approved QA: liquid_depth_ratio_pair_native.png and liquid_depth_ratio_main_compare_360.png. Preserve original frozen previews as historical material review; their ry4 liquid is superseded.
